name: Returning Home
summary: In Dun Morogh, a summons calls night elf priests back to Darnassus. Maxan Anvol sends them to Priestess Alathea at the Temple of the Moon.

sections.title: A Summons Across the Sea
sections.body: In Kharanos, Maxan Anvol sees a night elf endure Dun Morogh's bitter cold, far from Teldrassil's serene forests. The dwarven priest trainer brings urgent news. A priestess of Elune passed through seeking you with orders from Darnassus. They call you back at once.

sections.title: The Temple of the Moon
sections.body: Your road leads across the sea to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, beneath Teldrassil's sacred boughs. Priestess Alathea welcomes you back to the Sisterhood of Elune, relieved that you returned safely from foreign lands. She prepares your next rites of devotion, beginning with the Stars of Elune.

faq.q: Who sends me on this quest?
faq.answer: Maxan Anvol, the dwarven priest trainer in Kharanos, delivers the message. He says another night elf priestess passed through Dun Morogh seeking you.

faq.q: Where do I need to go to complete it?
faq.answer: Return to Darnassus, on Teldrassil in northern Kalimdor. Priestess Alathea awaits inside the Temple of the Moon.

faq.q: Why is the Temple of the Moon calling me back?
faq.answer: Priestess Alathea and High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind watch over the growth of young initiates. Alathea wants to know you are safe, hear of your travels under Elune's grace, and begin your next spiritual training with the Stars of Elune.

faq.q: What happens after speaking with Priestess Alathea?
faq.answer: When you report your return, Priestess Alathea offers Stars of Elune. It continues your first rites as a Kaldorei priest.

faq.q: Why would a night elf be in Dun Morogh at level 10?
faq.answer: Night elf adventurers can sail from Darkshore to Menethil Harbor in the Eastern Kingdoms. From there, they can explore Alliance lands or travel with dwarf and gnome comrades.

faq.q: Is this quest available to other races?
faq.answer: No. This is for night elf priests training in dwarven lands, and it sends them back to their cultural and spiritual home in Darnassus.

angles.text: As a priest, you return from distant lands to the Sisterhood of Elune's leaders, keeping your devotion to the Moon Goddess steadfast.
As a Kaldorei in Dun Morogh's frigid winds, you receive a welcome call back to Teldrassil's familiar sanctuaries and ancestral forests.
